question.worked_solution:
The complement of $X,$ denoted $\overset{―}{X},$ consists of every element in the universal set $U$ that is not in the set $X.$

The universal set $U$ consists of the integers $0$ through $50,$ while the set $X$ consists of the integers $40$ through $50.$

So, the only elements of $U$ that are not in $A$ are the integers $0$ through $39.$

Therefore, the complement of $X$ is

$$
\overset{―}{X}={0,1,2,…,39}.
$$
